programs.title: Runaway Bride
programs.desc: (CC) Catch Her If You Can. 'Roberts and Gere confirm their status as an eternal screen team' in this delightful laugh-filled romantic comedy. Roberts plays small-town girl Maggie Carpenter, whose marches down the aisle become a series of near Mrs. when she bolts before saying 'I do.' Gere is Ike Graham, a cynical, big-city newspaper columnist eager to write a tell-all story about Maggie. But the more Ike finds out about the skittish Maggie, the more he finds he's falling in love.
